sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, opening paragraphs through note 4. Odoacer in 476, the eastern emperor Zeno’s mandate, the Italian campaign in 489, the agreement and killing in 493, and Theoderic’s death in 526.
Pars posterior 53–56. Camp in the Pineta, reported price of a measure of wheat, difficulties during the siege, entry into Ravenna and Odoacer’s death.

labels.de: Odoakers Tod und Theoderichs Einzug in Ravenna
labels.en: Odoacer’s death and Theoderic’s entry into Ravenna

note.de: Die Gegner einigten sich auf geteilte Herrschaft. Kurz nach seinem Einzug tötete Theoderich Odoaker. Theoderichs Heer rief ihn zum König aus.
note.en: The opponents agreed to share power. Shortly after entering Ravenna Theoderic killed Odoacer. His army acclaimed him as king.
